config.cloudflare_tunnel.quick_project_h: Publishes a snapshot of the selected project's latest built static files. Enable Homepage and Cloudflare. AuraGo allocates the port automatically.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.quick_project_e: Project unavailable. Check Homepage settings and project registration.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.info: Securely expose local services to the internet through Cloudflare's global network using cloudflared. Supports Docker and native binary modes.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.disabled_desc: Enable the toggle to manage Cloudflare Tunnels for secure remote access to your local services.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.token_hint: Store your Cloudflare connector token in the Secrets Vault with key 'cloudflared_token'.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.named_hint: Store your tunnel credentials.json content in the Secrets Vault with key 'cloudflared_credentials'.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.expose_single_h: Token routes are managed in the Cloudflare dashboard. This choice controls the local loopback target; named tunnels require explicit routes.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.expose_named_hi: Enter a JSON array of routes with hostname or path and an HTTP(S) service origin. Unmatched requests return 404. Example: [{"hostname":"site.example.com","service":"http://localhost:3000"}].
config.cloudflare_tunnel.loopback_label: Loopback HTTP port for cloudflared (avoids TLS)
config.cloudflare_tunnel.loopback_hint: Opens HTTP on 127.0.0.1. The suggested port is 18080; you can change it. Configure the corresponding HTTP origin in Cloudflare.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.general_desc: Enable the tunnel and configure basic settings.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.connection_desc: Configure tunnel connection and authentication settings.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.enabled_help: Turns Cloudflare Tunnel management on for AuraGo.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.readonly_help: Limits the integration to status checks and blocks tunnel changes.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.auto_start_help: Starts cloudflared automatically when AuraGo starts.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.mode_help: Choose whether AuraGo should use Docker, a native binary, or auto-detect the best runtime.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.auth_method_hel: Select how the tunnel authenticates with Cloudflare.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.tunnel_name_hel: Name of the named tunnel in Cloudflare. Required only for named tunnels.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.account_id_help: Optional Cloudflare account ID used by named tunnel operations.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.metrics_port_he: 0 automatically assigns a local metrics port; metrics remain enabled.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.log_level_help: Controls how much cloudflared logging AuraGo records.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.expose_web_ui_h: Routes the AuraGo Web UI through the tunnel.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.expose_homepage: Routes the Homepage web server through the tunnel.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.expose_target_h: Token routes are managed in the Cloudflare dashboard. This choice controls the local loopback target; named tunnels require explicit routes.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.actions_help: Actions use saved settings. Save your changes before starting or restarting.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.port_help: 0 keeps the default. Use integer ports 1–65535; ports below 1024 may require extra privileges.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.port_conflict: This port conflicts with an active listener.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.tls_warning: The connector may be running, but TLS origin configuration could not be verified. Configure loopback HTTP or check the origin settings in Cloudflare.
config.cloudflare_tunnel.custom_ingress_: Enter a JSON array of routes with hostname or path and an HTTP(S) service origin. Unmatched requests return 404. Example: [{"hostname":"site.example.com","service":"http://localhost:3000"}].
config.cloudflare_tunnel.defaults_help: Omitted auto-start and publication flags are false. Explicit template values still apply.
